fixed: The opening's big words lay over her face; she stands at the far end of the sink now and the words sit over the kitchen.
The tally page covered her face; the page shots have nobody in them, the page fills the picture.
The ONE YEAR EARLIER stamp of the rewind landed across both faces in the wide picture; it is smaller and higher in a wide frame now.
The blue notebook fell past her face onto the counter; it drops beside her, from less high.
notes: Midnight in the kitchen: she writes in her blue notebook at the sink under SHE WROTE DOWN / EVERY DISH SHE WASHED / FOR A WHOLE YEAR; the tally page fills and counts up to 4,212; she shuts the notebook and looks at us. The film runs back to ONE YEAR EARLIER: winter, the fight at the full sink, her pointing, his shrug, I DO EVERYTHING against I DO PLENTY, he walks off; her rule, the notebook dropping onto the counter; at the table with it. Faces change on some cuts in the quick back and forth of the fight: kept, the fight is the cause.
